## Checklist

- [ ] Ran `node registry/validate.mjs`
- [ ] `version` matches the release tag
- [ ] `tag` or `commit` is fixed (not the default branch)
- [ ] `trust` is `community`
- [ ] `id` and `repo` are not duplicated
- [ ] README/docs links are relative and working
